request: Was habe ich 2025 pro Supermarkt ausgegeben? Auf dem Auszug stehen die als KAUFLAND BERLIN, REWE Markt GmbH, LIDL Vertriebs GmbH, ALDI SUED und NETTO MARKEN-DISCOUNT.

plan.question: Spending of 2025 per supermarket, one row per merchant, ordered by the figure, columns merchant and total_eur.

request: Show me how the PayPal payments add up over 2025.

plan.title: PayPal payments, running total
plan.question: The running total of the spending on bookings whose counterparty is PayPal over the months of 2025, one row per month, columns month as 'YYYY-MM' and cumulative_eur.

sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', booked_on) AS month, -SUM(amount) AS total
  FROM transaction_view
  WHERE amount < 0 AND counterparty LIKE 'PayPal%' AND booked_on >= '2025-11-01'
  GROUP BY month
)
SELECT month, ROUND(SUM(total) OVER (ORDER BY month), 2) AS cumulative_eur
FROM monthly
ORDER BY month
reasoning_plan:
the request is written in English, so language en
"add up" is a running total over the months, not a figure per month
an area is the shape for a running total
the PayPal bookings are the ones whose counterparty carries that name, whoever the payee was
the columns are month and cumulative_eur, the period is the whole of 2025
reasoning_code:
the shape is area, so areaY draws the band and lineY its edge
the columns are month and cumulative_eur, and cumulative_eur holds the numbers
month on x with monthShort, euros on y
an area rests on zero, so its euro axis is the bare scaleLinear factory
